text: Global Institute of Management & Economic (GIME) at Dongbei University of Finance and Economic (DUFE) offer an MSc in TM (Tourism Management) based on teaching and research, complemented with practical application of learning during internship. As forecasted by the World Tourism Organization, China will be the world’s leading tourism destination by 2020. This prediction has important implications for businesses both directly and indirectly related to the tourism industry, leading to many employment opportunities. As such, the need to educate and prepare sufficient qualified managers to lead the expansion is eminent. Hence, we aims to integrate humanistic spirit and professional knowledge into university education, to train graduates with global competitiveness and with international perspectives, and to provide intellectual resources and support for management practice for the industry. The Masters of Science in Tourism Management (MSc) is designed for international university graduates from any discipline and profession seeking to advance their careers in the international tourism industry. This program includes theoretical, empirical and practical components to prepare candidates to work in public and private tourism and tourism related enterprises after graduation. The medium of teaching is the English language. However, international students with no prior knowledge of the Chinese language are required to study Chinese reading and writing taught partly in the Chinese language. Candidates enrolled in this program are expected to engage in extensive self-studying on the topics covered during contact time. Start Date: Semester1: September to next January Winter Vacation: January and February Semester2: March to July Summer Vacation: July and August
